steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: An ore is a naturally occurring mineral from which a metal can be economically extracted | Key Fact: Hydrothermal ore deposits: metal-rich hot fluids deposit minerals in veins and fractures (e.g. tin in Cornwall, gold veins) | Key Fact: Placer deposits: heavy minerals concentrated by river or wave action (e.g. gold, diamond placers) | Key Fact: Fossil fuels: coal (from Carboniferous swamp forests), petroleum (from marine microorganisms under heat and pressure)

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from economic geology &amp; resources, and one past-paper question.
